title: 信息日报 2026-09-23

headline.title: Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Sol 与 GPT-6 Luna 发布，新一轮价格战开启
headline.summary: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5.5，OpenAI 随后推出 GPT-6 Sol 与 GPT-6 Luna，并下调价格，形成新一轮价格战。开发者工具 llm-anthropic 0.29、llm 0.36 等迅速适配。分析称，新模型能力与成本平衡仍需实测，但竞争已显著压低推理价格。
headline.title_en: Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, and a new price war
headline.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5, and OpenAI followed with GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, cutting prices to roughly half of comparable prior models. Developer tooling, including llm-anthropic 0.29 and llm 0.36, quickly added support. The releases mark a new price war in frontier AI, though independent evaluations are still needed to judge capability and cost trade-offs.
headline.original_title: Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, and a new price war
headline.reason: 该文同时覆盖当天两大模型发布和定价变化，是 AI 与开发版面的交汇点，且直接触发新一轮价格战，读者关注度最高。
headline.reason_en: It captures the day’s two major model launches and pricing shift, sits at the intersection of AI and developer news, and signals a new price war likely to affect costs across the industry.
